Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose one inhabited city block you can examine. Name a place within 6 squares in the examined block that you want to reach. You and the DA establish a previously unmentioned concealed service entrance, roof path or passage from your current public location toward that place, consistent with the building's structure and established facts. The DA describes its entrance, exit and any obstacle along it. The route becomes an established feature your party can use.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
Ten minutes examining one inhabited city block.
Target / range / shape
One inhabited city block you can examine.
Limits
Once per scene.
Type
Skill / Utility
